snippet.title: Nazizombie's Slayer - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The hardcore top-down pixel shooter Nazizombie's Slayer is coming on November 5, 2025!

Become an adamantium mercenary and obliterate your enemies in this action-packed game with adventure elements. Complete contracts, upgrade your gear, explore challenging levels, and unravel a dark plot.

Get ready for some tough and engaging gameplay!

Wishlist on Steam!
